authority_rule: The original published study is the only source of truth. Every claim scored must trace to one of this study's primary_sources, with a page, table or figure reference. If a finding in this registry is not supported by the source, mark it not_testable with reason claim_not_in_any_source and say so; the registry can be wrong, the study cannot.

primary_sources.cite: Carroll et al., PLOS Genetics 2011, doi:10.1371/journal.pgen.1002117

replication_targets.finding: S106P and L111Q switch AncCR specificity toward cortisol; introduced alone into AncCR they yield a non-functional receptor.
replication_targets.source: Ortlund 2007; residue tokens S106P and L111Q appear 11 and 10 times
replication_targets.test: Does epistaeon rank the 106-111 pair as coupled, and does it place the permissive group before them in the ordering?

replication_targets.finding: Permissive substitutions (group X) include Y27R, L29M, F98I, Q105L, N26T, S212D; they are required before the switch is tolerated.
replication_targets.test: Recall of these positions among epistaeon's detected partners of 106/111.

replication_targets.finding: The functional shift is contingent: reversal is blocked by later substitutions (epistatic ratchet).
replication_targets.test: Does epistaeon's path likelihood show asymmetry between forward and reverse orderings?

structures.notes: 7PRX is the wild-type human GR ligand-binding domain, 2.20 A, residues 529-776 complete, numbering equal to UniProt P04150. The resurrected ancestral receptors (AncCR 2Q1H/2Q1V/2Q3Y, AncGR1 3RY9, AncGR2 3GN8) are in ../data/ancestral_coordinates/ and use local LBD numbering: add 531 to reach human GR. In 3GN8 that offset breaks after about position 212.

known_limitations: The NR3C1 TOGA2 reference is the GR-gamma isoform: positions after 451 are one higher than UniProt / 7PRX numbering. Misapplying this shifts the entire ligand-binding domain by one residue, silently.
The experimental landscape is 16 genotypes (4 sites), while the AncGR1 to AncGR2 branch carries 39 substitutions. Any lattice must be scoped to the assayed sites.
The Carroll 2011 stability table is calculated, not measured.
No cortisol-bound ancestral structure exists. 2Q1V is titled cortisol but its deposited ligand is prednisone.
expected_outcome_note: The strongest case available: real resurrected ancestral sequences, a real combinatorial panel, and full species coverage. If epistaeon cannot replicate here, it is unlikely to replicate anywhere.
